think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any allowed numeric value is designated to switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto/infinite), typically via sentinel values like -1 or 0 that override normal ordered semantics. 3) If such a sentinel exists and changes behavior beyond just ‘smaller/larger’, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). Otherwise, classify as non-special.
